annotations.title: Add a product or a digital plan to a named list

description: Adds a product (`product_slug`) or a digital service plan (`digital_id`, a plan id of compare_digital / compare_mobile, e.g. claude-pro) to one of the signed-in person's lists with an optional private note; send exactly one of the two. For a product its total for `deliver_to_country` today is kept as saved_total (for "the price changed since you saved it"); a plan keeps no saved price. Adding it again only changes the note. At most 200 items per list. Another person's list answers not_found.

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

digital_id.description: A plan id of compare_digital / compare_mobile rows (e.g. claude-pro).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

note.description: A private note to the product (at most 280 characters); never shown on the share link.

name: add_to_list
title: Add a product or a digital plan to a named list
